upatthara.p: [Upa+atthara] (ti) CL=7 (1) The flooring sheet that covers the upper portion. (Ti) (2) Broad or wide and flat. Covers a wide area.

အခင်း။ ကော်ဇော။
DOP: upatthara m. [ from *upa + tharati; cf S. upastara], what is spread out below; a carpet or rug; a plain; a platform ; Ja VI 534, 32* (padumā … jannutagghā ~ā; 535, 4´ : ~ā ti jannupamāṇe udake ~ā phullā honti santhatā viya khāyanti); — ifc see pabbat’-ū-, rath’-ū-; — see also upattha.
CPD: 2 upatthara , m. (?) [ sa. *upastara = upa- staraṇa ?], ifc. pabbat'ū ° ( plateau ? Ja ll 126, 6* ); rath'u ° ( i. q. rath'upattha, see 2 upattha; D l 103, 31 , Sv 273, 1 : rathamhi rañño than'atthaṃ attharitvā sajjita-padese, RhD: footrug, PED carpet, rug, R. O.
